sloka: गिरि प्रस्थास्तु सौमित्रे सर्वतः संप्रपुष्पितैः ।निष्पत्रैः सर्वतो रम्यैः प्रदीप्ता इव किंशुकैः ॥४-१-७५॥
transliteration: giri prasthāstu saumitre sarvataḥ saṁprapuṣpitaiḥ ।niṣpatraiḥ sarvato ramyaiḥ pradīptā iva kiṁśukaiḥ ॥4-1-75॥

translations.english: 'Very closely grown on the banks of Pampa, stand malati, mallika and karavira trees with their clusters of fragrant blossoms.
